ColonyCouncil.ArcDef.label: the fear laid to rest
ColonyCouncil.ArcDef.summary: The enemy who hurt them is in the colony's cells, or gone for good, but the fear isn't. Taking it in, telling a friend the whole of it, and a few good nights lay it to rest.

li.label: over, mostly
li.waiting: Next: a few days for {PAWN_nameDef} to take it in.

plain.li: [captured] {NAME} is in our cells now. I walk the long way round so I don't pass that door.
[captured] They say {NAME} can't hurt anyone from in there. My hands didn't get the message.
[dead] {NAME} is dead. I keep waiting to feel something about it, and what comes is the old fear.
[dead,beast] They brought {NAME} down at last. I went to look at the body, to be sure. It looked smaller than I remembered.
[released] We let {NAME} go. I understand why. I still check the road every morning.
[joined] {NAME} eats at our table now. I sit at the far end and watch {NAME}'s hands.
[gone] {NAME} hasn't been seen in months. That should help. It doesn't, quite.
It's over. I've been told so four times today.

warm.li: It's over, and the others keep checking on me. I wish I could tell them it's working.

cheerful.li: The danger's past, they say. Now I just have to convince the rest of me.

gloomy.li: The one who hurt me can't any more. The fear doesn't seem to care.

cold.li: The threat is resolved. The fear is a habit now, and habits can be broken.

chronicle.li: [captured] {PAWN_nameDef} walks the long way round now, so as not to pass the cell where {NAME} is kept.
{PAWN_nameDef} is still afraid of {NAME}, though it's over.

li.label: telling it
li.waiting: Next: {PAWN_nameDef} tells someone the whole of it.

plain.li: I've never told anyone what it was like, that day with {NAME}. I think I'm going to have to.
[captured] I went and stood outside the cell today, and didn't go in. Next time I'll tell someone why.
The fear is smaller in daylight. I'd like to say it out loud before it grows back.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} keeps asking how I am, gently. I think I'm going to answer properly.

blunt.li: Need to talk about it. Will.

gloomy.li: Telling it means living it again. I'll do it anyway.

cold.li: A full account, to someone I trust, once. Then I can stop rehearsing it at night.

chronicle.li: There are things about {NAME} that {PAWN_nameDef} has never told anyone.

li.label: said out loud
li.waiting: Next: a few good days and quiet nights for {PAWN_nameDef}.

plain.li: Told it all, start to finish. My voice shook in the middle. Then it stopped shaking.
Now someone else knows what {NAME} did, I don't have to carry it on my own.
[captured] Maybe one day I'll go and look {NAME} in the face. Maybe I won't need to.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} listened to the whole thing and then just sat with me. That was the part that helped.

cheerful.li: Talking helped! I ate a whole breakfast this morning, the first in a while.

gloomy.li: I said it all out loud. It sounded smaller than it felt.

cold.li: The account is given. The rest is sleep and time.

chronicle.li: Late one evening {PAWN_nameDef} told the whole of it, everything {NAME} did, start to finish.

plain.li: Slept the whole night through, and didn't dream of {NAME}. I didn't notice until breakfast.
[captured] Walked past {NAME}'s door today without changing my step. That's the end of it.
[dead] {NAME} is dead, and I'm alive, and today that's simply true.
[joined] {NAME} handed me a bowl at supper and I took it without thinking. I only noticed afterwards.
[gone,beast] I walked out past the trees where {NAME} used to wait, and only birds came out of them.

warm.li: I'm not afraid any more. I keep wanting to thank everyone, and I don't know how to say it.

cheerful.li: The fear's gone! I'd thought it had moved in for good.

gloomy.li: It's gone. I'm not sure what I'll blame my bad moods on now.

cold.li: The fear has run its course. I sleep through the night and work through the day, as before.

chronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef} has laid the fear of {NAME} to rest.
[captured] {PAWN_nameDef} can walk past {NAME}'s cell now without a second look.

plain.li: [timeout] It's over, they say, and I'm still afraid. Maybe that just takes longer.
[escaped] {NAME} is out. Of course {NAME} is out. The fear was right all along.
I tried to put the fear of {NAME} down. Not yet, it seems.

warm.li: [timeout] The fear's still with me, but so are the others. That will have to do.

blunt.li: [escaped] {NAME} got out. Here we go again.

gloomy.li: [timeout] I tried to put it down. It's heavier than I thought.

fizzleChronicle.li: [escaped] {PAWN_nameDef}'s fear came back the day {NAME} got away.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} was finally letting go of the fear. I hope {OTHER_pronoun} had done it by the end.

rulesStrings.li: r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] talked late about the enemy who once hurt one of them, and the day it happened.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] went over the old fight from start to finish, slowly, until it was only a story.
r_logentry->Over the washing-up, [INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] talked about an old enemy, and the bad nights since.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] talked about being afraid, and agreed it was nothing to be ashamed of.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] said the enemy's name out loud between them until it was just a name.

li.label: laid the fear to rest
li.description: The one who hurt me can't any more, and at last my hands believe it too.
